title: Minimalstic skyblock
body:
# - 📦 Minimalistic SkyBlock - Minimalistic SkyBlock is an ultra-clean Hypixel SkyBlock modpack focused on clarity, performance, and pure QoL — no clutter, no pointless overlays, no distractions. - Every mod is carefully chosen and pre-configured to give you only what actually helps while keeping the screen clean and FPS high. This pack is made for players who want to play better, not stare at 20 HUD elements. - ✨ What this pack focuses on - Essential SkyBlock QoL (dungeons, slayers, farming, mining, events) - Minimal & clean UI with sensible defaults - Strong performance optimizations - No unnecessary visual noise - Pre-configured configs so it works out of the box - 🔧 Included features - Smart SkyBlock helpers (dungeons, slayers, farming, mining, Rift, Crimson Isle) - Advanced chat filtering & cleanup - Clean HUD widgets with full control - FPS & memory optimizations - Quality-of-life tweaks that don’t change vanilla feel - 🚫 What this pack is NOT - ❌ No bloated HUDs - ❌ No meme or cosmetic spam - ❌ No unnecessary automation - ❌ No FPS-killing visuals - 🎯 Who this is for - Players who want maximum usefulness with minimum clutter - Mid-game to end-game SkyBlock players - Anyone tired of bloated SkyBlock modpacks - Install and play — everything is already tuned.
# Installed Mods (39) ### ## 🌌 SkyBlock Core * Firmament * Skyblocker * SkyHanni * SkyblockAddons Unofficial * SkyOcean * SkyCofl * Bazaar Utils * CrashAssistant ## 🏰 Dungeons * Odin * Rei’s Secret Bar Calculations ## 🧰 Utility * SkyBlock Profile Viewer * Roughly Enough Items (REI) * Resourceify ## ⚡ Performance & Optimization * Sodium * Sodium Extra * Reese’s Sodium Options * Lithium * FerriteCore * Entity Culling * ImmediatelyFast * Dynamic FPS * Noxesium * BadOptimizations ## 🎨 Graphics * Iris Shaders ## 💬 Chat & Interface * Chat Heads * Chat Patches * Tooltip Scroll * Zen ## 🌐 Multiplayer & Social * Essential Mod ## ⚙️ Configuration & Menu * Mod Menu * Cloth Config API * YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) * Text Placeholder API ## 📚 Libraries & Dependencies * Fabric API * Fabric Language Kotlin * Architectury API * owo-lib * Hypixel Mod API * Ducky Updater * Essential Dependencies * Log Cleaner * YOSBR
# 🎨 Included Resource Packs (2) ### SkyBlock Visuals - **FurfSky Legacy** – High-quality Hypixel SkyBlock item textures and overlays ### UI Improvements - **Skyblock Dark UI** – Dark-themed SkyBlock interface for a cleaner look
> Also, if you would like to gain a bit more Performance and dont care about the more modern scoreboard or item pickup log, you can delete SBA and the custom scoreboard. My main use for SBA is just as an item pickup log, and the custom scoreboard is to make the game look a bit more modern Frequent Updates This modpack is actively maintained and will receive frequent updates. Whenever new SkyBlock mods release, important features are added, or existing mods become outdated or discontinued, the pack will be updated to keep everything working smoothly. And also frequent updates on our dungeon discord server Our goal is to keep the modpack stable, minimalistic, and up to date so players always have the best possible SkyBlock experience.
